description: Given 2-8 cities, find the UTC hours where everyone sits inside acceptable local business hours (default 9-17) for a given date — DST-correct via the IANA tz database. Returns every feasible hour with each city's local time, or the best partial-overlap hours if none fit. Use this when an agent needs to find hours that work across cities, DST-correct. x402 price $0.02/call (USDC, eip155:8453).
name: geo_time_meeting_planner
